description: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells stainless steel flow solutions in India and internationally. It operates through Flexible Packaging, Flexible Flow Solutions, Engineering Services, Financing, and Others segments. The company manufactures metallic flexible flow solutions; produces PP Woven Bags, HDPE Box Bags, Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers (FIBCs) and BOPP Bags; financial services for individuals, businesses and institutions; micro, small, and medium enterprises financing; working capital solutions; and general trading activities, as well as consumer financing and loans, education loans, and loans to corporations and firms. It also provides advanced engineering and flexible metal flow solutions for high-performance industrial applications; stainless steel flexible hoses assemblies, fittings, and others value added products, such as metal bellows and high-performance liquid cooling solutions. In addition, the company engages in the business of international trading, investment and finance, leasing of assets; and manufacturing flexible packaging, hose pipes, engineering services etc. Further, it provides strategic guidance, operational expertise, and access to industry networks; and knowledge-based engineering and advanced manufacturing, tech enabled industrial and utility services, financial services, strategic investments, and a vibrant portfolio of emerging ventures. The company was formerly known as Sat Industries Limited and changed its name to Aeroflex Enterprises Limited in May 2025. Aeroflex Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
